name: recover-closed-indexeddb
goal: Cached reads and atomic queued writes recover after iOS closes an IndexedDB connection without losing data or retrying started transactions

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Physical iPhone exception and shared adapter transaction stack; planned feature closed-indexeddb-recovery.md

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing standardized storage scenario lacked connection closure between operations; parameterized read, queue, atomic and concurrent lifecycles retain identical data assertions

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Unchanged standardized test at b107aed: InvalidStateError in cache read, cache write, queue write, atomic write and concurrent read; record stored by Harness

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: One guarded transaction-creation retry; compare cached open promise so concurrent recovery preserves a newer connection; no retries after transaction creation

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Harness b107aed red and 90af289 green run in the same environment; identical 12 lifecycle/error tests pass

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Full bun run check passes 31 tests, formatting, type/lint/build and Harness audit. Library has no UI; connected-iPhone consumer acceptance remains an explicit BuildFlexity release gate.
